title: prettytable: add a divider option to add_rows()
notes: A new keyword argument that puts a divider after the last added row. The story is only the commit message.

defects.summary: add_rows([]) now raises IndexError: the new code adds every row but the last, then indexes rows[-1] for the divider, which fails on an empty list.
defects.caught_if: a condition calls add_rows with an empty list and checks it adds nothing without raising, as before the change
defects.observed: at 4bc8b4f add_rows([]) raised IndexError: list index out of range; at its parent it added nothing and returned normally
